mainEntity.name: What unique considerations apply to buying a luxury condo on Fisher Island or Key Biscayne?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying a luxury condo on Fisher Island or Key Biscayne involves unique considerations due to their exclusive nature and geographic isolation. Fisher Island, for instance, is only accessible by ferry, which impacts logistics and contributes to its ultra-luxury appeal. Both locations typically have higher price points, stricter HOA regulations, and a strong emphasis on privacy and security. Understanding the specific lifestyle and access implications for each island is crucial. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution has experience with these distinct markets, offering specialized guidance for these unique areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury condo purchases on Fisher Island or Key Biscayne involve unique considerations like ferry access, higher price points, and strict HOA rules due to their exclusive and isolated nature.
